log_file.description: Path to the log file for designate-worker.

host.description: Hostname for this worker instance. Leave empty to auto-detect.

transport_url.description: Message broker connection URL (e.g., RabbitMQ, Redis).

project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain name for the service project.

project_name.description: Keystone project name under which the service runs.

user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain name for the service user.

username.description: Keystone username for the Designate service.

password.description: Keystone password for the Designate service user (should be provided securely, e.g., via config file permissions or secrets manager).

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn.

threads.description: Number of threads per worker process.

periodic_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between periodic task runs (e.g., cleanup, zone sync).

max_concurrent_updates.description: Maximum number of concurrent outgoing DNS update requests to DNS backends.

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts for failed DNS updates.

enabled_export.description: Enable zone export to local files.

export_dir.description: Directory where zone export files are stored when enabled.

default_pool_id.description: ID of the default pool for zone assignments. Used when zone creation omits a pool ID.

storage_connection.description: Database connection string for zone/pool data persistence.

storage_pool_size.description: Maximum number of database connections in the pool.

storage_pool_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for acquiring a connection from the pool.

name.description: Logical name of the BIND9 server (used as section suffix).

api_key.description: API key for authenticating with the BIND9 server.

md5_auth_key.description: Optional MD5 key for TSIG authentication of dynamic updates (if BIND9 uses TSIG).

tsig_key_name.description: Optional TSIG key name used in BIND9 config (if applicable).

bind9_servers.description: List of BIND9 DNS servers to manage (only needed if using BIND9 backend).

notifier_enabled.description: Enable custom event notifications (e.g., for external monitoring or audit).

options.description: Backend-specific configuration options as key-value pairs.

notifier_endpoints.description: List of custom notifier endpoints with their configuration.
